errors.text_span: Линията на индекса SOFIX е синя, с плътна линия и кръгли маркери
errors.evidence: The description states that the SOFIX line has round markers ("кръгли маркери"), but the line in the chart is a simple solid line with no visible markers.

errors.text_span: расте постепенно до около 900 към края на 2004 г.
errors.evidence: The value of the SOFIX index at the end of 2004 is approximately 500, not 900. It reaches 900 in 2006.

errors.text_span: преди да се спусне рязко до около 200 през 2009 г.
errors.evidence: The SOFIX index drops to a low of approximately 300 in 2009, not 200.
The peak for the SOFIX index around 2017-2018 is closer to 700, not 600.

errors.text_span: Линията на индекса BG40 е червена, с плътна линия и кръгли маркери
errors.evidence: The description states that the BG40 line has round markers ("кръгли маркери"), but the line in the chart is a simple solid line with no visible markers.

errors.text_span: и започва при стойност около 100 в 2001 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the red line (BG40) starts in 2001. The chart shows it starting in 2005 at a value of approximately 200 (on the right scale).

errors.text_span: Расте постепенно до около 350 към края на 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The peak for the BG40 index is in late 2007/early 2008 and its value is approximately 450 (on the right scale), not 350.

errors.text_span: След това се възстановява, достигайки върхове около 300 през 2017 г., и се движи в диапазон между 200 и 300 до края на периода, завършвайки около 250 в 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the behavior of the BG40 (red) line after 2014. The line is not present on the graph for the period 2017-2021.

errors.text_span: Линията на индекса BGBX40 е зелена, с плътна линия и кръгли маркери
errors.evidence: The description states that the BGBX40 line has round markers ("кръгли маркери"), but the line in the chart is a simple solid line with no visible markers.

errors.text_span: и започва при стойност около 100 в 2001 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the green line (BGBX40) starts in 2001. The chart shows it starting in mid-2014 at a value of approximately 200 (on the right scale).

errors.text_span: След това се движи в диапазон между 100 и 200 до края на 2014 г.
errors.evidence: The BGBX40 (green) line only begins in mid-2014, so it does not move within a range until the end of 2014.
The peak for the BGBX40 index in 2018 is at a value of approximately 150 (on the right scale), not 200.

errors.text_span: и се движи в диапазон между 150 и 200 до края на периода, завършвайки около 200 в 2021 г.
errors.evidence: In its final years, the BGBX40 line moves roughly between 100 and 150, and its final value in 2021 is approximately 150, not 200. The stated range is also incorrect.
